thread_text:
maya: Quick sync — planning lanes for onprem packaging + customer-managed networking. Need launch criteria and upgrade tolerances by Friday.
diego: +1. Can we split by installer type (operator / bundle / airgap)? That affects rollback options.
ahana: Field: customers want non-disruptive BGP handover and IP preservation for 2 major accounts.
sam: For operator installs we can support in-place patching. Bundle/airgap needs staged drain > apply > revert window.
maya: Proposed launch gates: 1) installer smoke tests, 2) network handoff docs + runbook, 3) rollback <15m for 95% flows.
jess: CS: add "customer signoff" checklist item — will require field validation on their staging network.
diego: Technical ask: we need an upgrade strategy matrix: minor patch vs major runtime ABI. Minor=hot-restart, Major=node-recreate.
ahana: Let's capture trigger points for tenant re-assignment and egress IP change. Customers can't tolerate IP breaks during business hours.
sam: Suggest 'canary-by-tenant' rollout with traffic-shaping + prefix KV-cache warmup.
maya: Agree. Also need policy for customer-managed BGP: we require BFD + hold time recommendations, and a failover AS-path policy.
diego: I'll add recommended BFD timers: 50ms/3, and a template bgp config in repo: https://go/redwood/onprem-bgp-template 
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: onprem-installer-docs v1.2 -> staging at 2026-04-15T07:00Z
ahana: Field asks: add 'egress IP pinning' flag to installer: --preserve-egress-ip
sam: Minimal upgrade path doc snippet (for internal use):

```
# minor: patch
kubectl rollout restart redwood-runtime
# major: node-replace
kubectl cordon, drain -> replace image -> uncordon
```

maya: Good start. Next steps: diego to draft upgrade matrix, sam to prototype canary flow, ahana + jess to draft customer signoff checklist. Check-in on Wed.
diego: will have draft by Tue EOD. + I'll add rollback playbook snippets.
jess: I'll prep customer-facing readout and validation script.
maya: Thanks — please add blockers here. If none, we'll slot for Q3 alpha.
